title: Concept: Dependency declared with a date-shaped version
description: package.json declares a date-shaped version, which carries no compatibility signal, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A calendar version cannot tell the resolver whether two releases are compatible, so a rollback or upgrade cannot be reasoned about from the manifest.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: A calendar version cannot tell the resolver whether two releases are compatible, so a rollback or upgrade cannot be reasoned about from the manifest.
